topics.label: Animals
facts: Animals are living things that can move, eat, and grow.
Birds, fish, dogs, cats, and elephants are all animals.
Some animals eat plants, some eat other animals, and some eat both.
Baby animals grow up to look like their parents.

questions.q: Which of these is an animal?
questions.fact: Dogs are animals because they are living things that move and eat.

questions.q: What do animals need to stay alive?
questions.fact: All animals need food and water to live and grow.
Cows say moo, and they give us milk.

questions.q: What do we call a baby dog?
questions.fact: A baby dog is called a puppy.

topics.label: My Body
facts: Your body has a head, arms, legs, hands, and feet.
Your heart beats all day and night to move blood around your body.
Your bones hold your body up and protect the soft parts inside.
You use your five senses to see, hear, smell, taste, and touch.

questions.q: What do you use to see?
questions.fact: Your eyes help you see the world around you.

questions.q: What part of your body pumps blood?
questions.fact: Your heart pumps blood to every part of your body.

questions.q: How many fingers do you have on both hands?
questions.fact: You have five fingers on each hand, so ten in all.
Bones are strong and hold your body up.

topics.label: Plants
facts: Plants are living things that grow in soil.
Plants need sunlight, water, and air to grow.
Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.
Many plants grow flowers, and flowers can grow into fruits with seeds.

questions.q: What do plants need to grow?
questions.fact: Plants need sunlight, water, and air to stay alive and grow.

questions.q: What part of a plant makes food using sunlight?
questions.fact: Leaves catch sunlight and use it to make food for the plant.
Most plants grow in soil, which holds their roots.
A tiny seed can grow into a whole new plant.

topics.label: Fruit and Vegetables
facts: A tomato is really a fruit, because it grows from the flower of the plant and holds seeds inside.
Carrots grow underground, and the orange part we eat is the root of the plant.
Bananas grow in bunches on tall plants that look like trees but are really giant herbs.
Vegetables like broccoli and cauliflower are the flowers of the plant, while lettuce leaves are the leaves we eat.

questions.q: Which of these is really a fruit, even though we eat it like a vegetable?
questions.fact: A tomato holds seeds and grows from a flower, so scientists call it a fruit.

questions.q: Which part of the carrot plant do we eat?
questions.fact: A carrot is the root of the plant, growing underground.

choices: On a bush in the desert
In bunches on a tall plant
questions.fact: Bananas grow in bunches on a tall plant that is really a giant herb.

questions.q: Which vegetable is the flower of its plant?
questions.fact: Broccoli is the flower head of its plant, picked before it opens.
